digest.component_or_area: acceptance criteria qualifier and completion verifier
propositions: Rename the canonical AC qualifier tag from [operator-attested] to [non-codebase] to clarify that the distinction is WHERE evidence lives (outside codebase) rather than WHO attests
Retain [operator-attested] as an undocumented compatibility alias to avoid reclassifying 827 existing immutable event-sourced tickets
Widen the canonical regex matcher and .rebar/criteria_routing.json activation trigger to accept both [non-codebase] and [operator-attested] case-insensitively with non-capturing alternation
Sequence reader-widening in src/rebar/audit/page.py before emitter changes to ensure legacy verdicts render identically regardless of kind wire value
Update all author-facing guidance, prompts, and generated surfaces to emit [non-codebase] only while instructing that both spellings are recognized
Create ADR-0101 to amend ADR-0043 documenting the rename rationale and alias retention policy
